newsitem.title: ISRAEL: CPI completes purchase of Phoenicia stake.
newsitem.headline: CPI completes purchase of Phoenicia stake.

text.p: Canada's Consumers Packaging Inc (CPI) has completed its purchase of a 25.1 percent stake in Israel's Phoenicia Glass Works Ltd, Phoenicia's parent company Koor Industries Ltd said on Tuesday.
Under the agreement, CPC is paying $4.35 million to Koor and will receive 17.5 percent of Phoenicia's equity immediately and another 7.6 percent in four months, Koor said.

The purchase is part of a strategic alliance formed between the two makers of glass packaging under which CPI will provide Phoenicia with the technology to make advanced glass-packaging products and help it enter overseas markets.
Phoenicia, which until now was wholly owned by Koor, has annual sales of about $30 million.
